title: Industrial chemicals scheme replaced with risk-based introduction rules (AICIS)
summary: From 1 July 2020 the Australian Industrial Chemicals Introduction Scheme replaced the earlier notification and assessment scheme. Businesses that import or make industrial chemicals register, and how much assessment a chemical needs depends on its risk.
direction_rationale: Chemical makers and importers had raised duplication, delays and a lack of consistency with international standards in chemicals regulation (Productivity Commission, 2008).

Industrial and Agricultural Chemical Product Wholesaling

verified.notes: Assent and commencement (1 July 2020) from section 2 of the Act as made.

assessment.summary: Risk-based categories mean low-risk chemicals need less assessment before they can be introduced, which should cut time and cost for importers and manufacturers.

marks.reason: Assessment effort is scaled to a chemical's risk, so low-risk introductions need less paperwork.

assessment.confidence_note: No evaluation of the new scheme was found; the mark rests on its design and earlier complaints.
